description: This file defines an interface ICacheMonitor responsible for monitoring cache-related metrics, including pressure status, message counts, memory usage, and cache size reporting within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ICacheMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring cache metrics in Orleans streaming system.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Tracks changes in the cache pressure monitor status, indicating if the cache is under pressure along with associated metrics.

methods.name: TrackMessagesAdded
methods.description: Records the number of messages added to the cache.

methods.name: TrackMessagesPurged
methods.description: Records the number of messages purged from the cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Logs memory allocated in bytes by the cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Logs memory released back to the block pool in bytes.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports statistics about the oldest and newest message enqueue/dequeue times and total message count.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the total cache size in bytes.
